plan.name: motor-learnability-v1
plan.training_augmentation: One independently sampled D4 orientation per selected training position, fixed before extraction. Validation uses natural orientation.
plan.features: All 2129 individual motor firing rates before learned readout gains. Core parameters and topology remain frozen; baseline logits are the original native predictions.
plan.gating: Keep at most 128 largest positive standardized motor deviations per position; stable motor-index tie breaking. External readout intervention only.
plan.initialization: Every residual output weight and bias is zero, so every arm starts at exactly the same native logits. MLP hidden weights use a seeded normal distribution with standard deviation 1/sqrt(2129).
plan.optimizer: Adam, beta1=.9, beta2=.999, epsilon outside sqrt, FP64 parameters/moments, global gradient clipping before moments.
plan.objective: Raw teacher policy cross entropy over legal moves. Value predictions and recurrent parameters remain fixed.
plan.selection: All 36 fixed-horizon results are reported, including failed or overconfident cases. Rate comparison is a diagnostic screen; do not promote a variant from its best seed or claim an equi-FLOP CNN win. Fresh-seed end-to-end studies follow any useful feature result.
plan.scope: Separate representation/decoder diagnostic motivated by the large CNN gap. The frozen core has 32000 prior labeled exposures; each head adds 131072 exposures to a fixed 16384-position training bank. Normalization sees only training features. Validation is a fixed 8192-position subset with held-out opening families, not the full 70425-position validation or final test. This does not test recurrent gating, new biological propagation, end-to-end sample efficiency, or playing strength. Never initialize TPU.

checks: All 36 fixed endpoints, initialization identity, fixed core, matching training/validation selections, family separation, source hashes, and archived bank/checkpoint hashes verified. Four mathematical probe tests passed before fitting.

interpretation: Raw residual mixing improves this frozen subset modestly. Higher rates and standardized competitive gating can produce sharp but worse held-out policies. These settings do not demonstrate optimal decoder fitting or an information/capacity limit; normalization changes optimization coordinates and may need much smaller rates or regularization.
